section_summary.extract_value: This section (Study X) reports a single study examining associations between online interpersonal sexual objectification (OISO), broad conceptualization of beauty, body appreciation, and intuitive eating in Chinese adolescent girls. Participants were 1152 Chinese girls aged 11–15 who completed a questionnaire; results indicated OISO was negatively associated with broad conceptualization of beauty and intuitive eating, and mediation analysis showed OISO related to lower intuitive eating via reduced broad conceptualization of beauty and body appreciation.
section_summary.evidence_source: Participants were 1152 Chinese adolescent girls aged 11 to 15 years who completed a questionnaire survey measuring OISO experiences, broad conceptualization of beauty, body appreciation, and intuitive eating. The results showed a negative association of OISO experiences with broad conceptualization of beauty and intuitive eating. Mediation analysis using structural equation modeling showed a negative association of OISO experiences with intuitive eating through broad conceptualization of beauty and body appreciation.
